# Task
Task: ajc-pic0av
Title: Pic^0 is an abelian variety of dimension g — tangent, smoothness, properness, degree
Project(s) — work across all of them:
- Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge
References: roadmap=AJC.pic0av,AJC.pic0av.tangent,AJC.pic0av.structure,AJC.pic0av.identity,AJC.rr.principal; inbox=I-0491,I-0074,I-0493,I-0495

CLOSE THE A.3 LEG: upgrade the Picard identity component to an abelian variety of dimension g. Roadmap AJC.pic0av and its three children (.tangent, .structure, .identity), plus AJC.rr.principal, which is the one-point local input the degree story needs.

THE FOUR OPEN FRONTS, with the actual sorry sites.

 (a) TANGENT / H1 COMPARISON (AJC.pic0av.tangent). Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean: tangentSpaceCotangentDual (:595, :612) and finrank_cotangentSpaceDual_eq_finrank_h1Cok (:672). Identify the cotangent-space dual at the identity with the Cech H1 cokernel and hence with H1(C, O_C), including the k-linearity and the finrank comparison. This is the scalar identity dim_k T_0 = g, and it is the load-bearing one: smoothness of relative dimension g reduces to it.

 (b) SMOOTHNESS AND PROPERNESS (AJC.pic0av.structure). Pic0AbelianVariety.lean smooth (:806) and proper (:826). Combine with the already-complete geometric-irreducibility and group-object infrastructure to obtain the abelian-variety structure. Note these two currently report CLEAN axioms as stated because they quantify over [HasPicScheme C] and the caller discharges it — so measure at a SYNTHESIS SITE, not at the declaration, or you will report a completeness number that is not true.

 (c) DEGREE AND DEGREE-ZERO POINTS (AJC.pic0av.identity). Picard/IdentityComponent.lean: Pic0Scheme (:1426), degree (:1432), finrank_eq_genus (:1475, :1494), kPoints_iff_kerDegree (:1504). Construct the degree map, identify Pic0(k) with its kernel, prove the dimension statement.

 (d) PRINCIPAL DIVISORS HAVE DEGREE ZERO (AJC.rr.principal). RiemannRoch/WeilDivisor.lean:1194, deliberately left in place. Read the roadmap node first: both items of the old two-item residue are closed and what remains is ONE input, a one-point local statement rather than a global identity. Do not re-derive the closed halves.

DISCIPLINE. Search before proving — horizon search spans your project AND mathlib AND the sibling Rebuild, whose RiemannRoch/ directory is 63 files / 17.8k lines and largely sorry-free; the lemma you need may be next door. Use the Lean LSP loop (lean_goal / lean_diagnostic_messages) between edits and keep lake build for session boundaries.

COORDINATION. You are one of four AJC teams. Your representability INTERFACE comes from ajc-etale-pic, which is re-stating it without the rational-point binder per the human decision of 2026-07-28 (protection I-0491) — agree the shape with them EARLY on the AJC conversation thread and do not build against the old [HasRationalPoint C] form. ajc-fbc owns Cohomology/; if you need a base-change fact from there, ask on the thread rather than editing their files. Never edit files outside Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge.

This is a headless, one-shot session: work the task's REAL objective as far
as you genuinely can, committing progress as you go, then finish with the
brief final report the skill specifies.
